name: Cockpit Preflight Checklist
description: Probe a causally linked cockpit panel, follow targets released by each calibration-bus action, and reconcile the hierarchical circuit tree.
natural_language: Calibrate from the first visible analog target; reaching each source target releases the next sealed target after moving that linked channel. Then reconcile the disclosed circuit rows and certify.

metadata.source_notes: Original panel informed by W3C ARIA APG multi-thumb slider, spinbutton, and treegrid interaction patterns, plus ComponentBench's component-state verification methodology.
metadata.notes: Synchronous causal-control puzzle. Analog actions reveal sealed downstream targets and physically alter linked channels; visible pointer gestures drive a transcript independently replayed by the server grader and exported verifier.
